title: Entitled DUI Karen Pepper-Sprayed After Wild High-Speed Chase Ends in Ditch!
description:
On April 1st, 2023, deputies in Washington responded to reports of an erratic driver on Highway 20. The suspect's vehicle, a white Mercedes, was observed veering across lanes and even driving onto the sidewalk. A deputy identified the vehicle and activated his emergency lights, witnessing several instances of dangerous driving. 

Despite the deputy's attempts to stop the vehicle with lights and sirens, the suspect continued driving, leading to a pursuit. The suspect's vehicle fluctuated in speed and continued to exhibit dangerous behavior, narrowly avoiding collisions with other vehicles. The pursuit spanned several highways and back roads, with the suspect ignoring repeated commands to stop. 

The chase concluded when the suspect's vehicle left the roadway, crashed into a ditch, and became stuck. Despite commands to exit the vehicle, the suspect remained non-compliant, leading deputies to break windows and deploy pepper spray. The suspect was forcibly removed, handcuffed, and cleared of injuries by EMTs. A DUI investigation confirmed the suspect’s intoxication, adding the charge of DUI. The suspect had a history of 2 prior DUI arrests.  The suspect was taken into custody, and their dog was remanded to the local animal shelter. The suspect was charged with DUI, Attempting to Elude a Police Vehicle, and Resisting Arrest.
